$comment: Phase 7 UK supplier references. Not a shop: these point at legitimate UK suppliers whose FE35 listings were read on the date in `checked`. `match` grades: `exact` = the supplier quotes an OEM number equal to the node's original part number read from the AGCO 819045 parts book (M/V suffix letter normalised); `agco-ref` = equal to one of the node's 2008 AGCO replacementReferences; `book-ref` = equal to one of the node's other partsBookReferences (TO35 book SRC-041, or a non-primary 819045 row such as an alternative or serial-dependent number) and nothing better matches; `listed-fit` = listed by the supplier for the FE35 / 23C, fit claimed by the supplier only; `check-fit` = listed for the FE35 but with a known reason to check before ordering (see notes). Prices in GBP as shown on the date checked; stock as shown on the listing page.

suppliers.name: Anglo Agriparts
suppliers.notes: UK aftermarket supplier with a dedicated Ferguson FE35 section (196 products on 2026-11-08). Product pages quote OEM numbers with the M suffix. Prices in GBP; the listing shows ex and inc VAT.

suppliers.name: Agriline Products
suppliers.notes: UK aftermarket supplier (+44 1527 579 111) with a Ferguson FE35 4-cylinder range split by system. The site states its parts are Agriline parts, not made by the original manufacturer unless stated. Some listings quote OEM numbers in the title.
